allowedSideEffect: Install only /usr/local/libexec/asi-ephemeral-dispatcher-recover and the systemd drop-in asi-ephemeral-dispatcher.service.d/recovery.conf on one.com, then daemon-reload. The helper may run as root solely for ExecStartPre. The main dispatcher process stays User=administrator. Do not enable, start, or restart the unit. Do not set ASI_DISPATCHER_EXECUTE. Do not widen the work directory. Do not clear NO_RETRY. Do not rebuild Gold. Do not change branch protection. Do not set ASI_PAID_CALLS_ENABLED. Do not change the spend cap. Do not remove HOLD from Issue #686.
postActionVerification: systemctl cat asi-ephemeral-dispatcher.service shows User=administrator and ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/libexec/asi-ephemeral-dispatcher-recover.
The work directory remains root:asi-landing-kvm mode 0710.
Logs under the work directory and the NO_RETRY file are unchanged.
The sealed Gold image remains root-owned, mode 0444, and its virtual size remains 42949672960 bytes.
ASI_DISPATCHER_EXECUTE remains NO, ASI_PAID_CALLS_ENABLED remains NO, and the spend ledger remains cap 0, paused 0, and paid call count 0.
scope: install the recovery drop-in and helper only
